Access for Individuals with Disabilities

Visitor Information
Council Office Building and Hearing Room Use

Under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the Montgomery County Council provides reasonable accommodations to ensure that people with disabilities have an equal opportunity to testify at public hearings. Email CouncilHearing.Accommodation@montgomerycountymd.gov or call the public hearing line (240-777-7803) at least five business days prior to the public hearing date to request an ADA accommodation (MD Relay - Dial 711 or 800-201-7165).

The Council also provides interpretation services if needed. Contact Bertha Cerzosimo (240-777-7871) or Lucia Jimenez (240-777-7832) at least five business days prior to the public hearing date to request interpretation services.

While we will make every effort to accommodate requests, late requests for an accommodation or interpretation services may not be able to be processed or accommodated. Please note that if we are unable to make a requested accommodation you may submit written, video, or audio testimony or mail sent to 100 Maryland Avenue, Rockville, MD 20850.
